items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Pearl Bailey was doing it on her show... And on the strength of that, I called up ASCAP

ctx.x: Yeah, I thought so. And that's the period when we had the big earthquake, and we were in Sylmar. I got completely wiped out. So on the strength of "Primrose Lane," Ella Fitzgerald was doing it, the Mills Brothers were doing it, Pearl Bailey was doing it on her show... And on the strength of that, I called up ASCAP and said, "I need some money right away." They said, "Well, what do you need?" So I said, "I need five thousand dollars in a hurry." And the second day after that, the check was in the mail. So thank…
